compiled_state.title: As a developer, I have a shared SESSION_BRANCH resolution helper script that provides consistent 3-step fallback logic for all ci-pr mode consumers
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Extract the 3-step SESSION_BRANCH resolution logic (draft PR headRefName → vars.SPRINT_SESSION_ID → fail-fast) into a single shared script (resolve-session-branch.sh) with unit tests covering all three fallback tiers and the explicit fail-fast path.

**Why**: Sprint Phase F (S2), Debug Phase F/G (S4), the provenance verifier (S5), and the migration script (S7) all require identical SESSION_BRANCH resolution. Three independent implementations will drift. A silent default to main is the worst-case failure mode — it would route sub-branch PRs against the wrong base, defeating the entire architecture.

**Scope**:
- IN: New script plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-session-branch.sh implementing the 3-step fallback; unit tests covering: (a) draft PR headRefName available → returns it, (b) headRefName unavailable but vars.SPRINT_SESSION_ID set → returns it, (c) both unavailable → exits non-zero with actionable error; script is idempotent and safe to call multiple times
- OUT: Changing any caller to use the script (that is S2, S4, S5, S7's responsibility); Ruleset enforcement (S3); workflow renaming (S1)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-session-branch.sh exists, is executable, and implements the 3-step fallback: (1) gh pr view --json headRefName for the draft session PR, (2) gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables/SPRINT_SESSION_ID, (3) exit non-zero with "ERROR: SESSION_BRANCH could not be resolved — ensure sprint Phase A completed"
  ← Satisfies: "SESSION_BRANCH resolution failure (critical, configuration): 3-step fallback" (Operational Constraint, SC4)
- When this story is complete, unit tests cover all three fallback tiers and the fail-fast exit path; tests pass
  ← Satisfies: unit test done-of-done
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] The fail-fast path (step 3) must never silently default to main. The error message must be actionable: it should identify which environment variable or gh api call failed and link to troubleshooting steps.
- [Maintainability] Callers (S2, S4, S5, S7) should source this script via the plugin shim path, not reference the plugin cache path directly.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
